core_premise: Paramedic Nia Calder hears a dying patient's final memory and finds immortal archivist Rowan inside it, but every life Nia saves erases one of Rowan's memories.
series_goal: Discover why their abilities are linked and stop the entity trading human survival for stolen memory.
theme: Love is not perfect remembrance; it is the choice to know someone again.
central_conflict: Nia will not stop saving patients, while Rowan fears each rescue will erase the evidence and identity needed to defeat the entity.
ending_direction: Nia and Rowan redirect the exchange into a voluntary shared archive, defeating the entity while accepting that some memories cannot be restored.
character_arc_targets: Nia learns that responsibility does not require solitary sacrifice. Rowan chooses present trust over controlling what remains of the past.
major_setup_payoff_refs: `SR-S1`: the silver emergency tag; `SR-S2`: Rowan's blank journal page; `SR-S3`: the phrase “remember me forward.”
